subject: Post-call: Lumetix POC technical qualifiers & success checkpoints
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Gray <sophie.gray@lumetix.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@lumetix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Lumetix POC technical qualifiers & success checkpoints

Hi Sophie / Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of what we agreed and the minimal scope for a 3-week pilot so your engineering team can validate feasibility and business impact. Please reply with any corrections.

POC objective (what success looks like):
- Validate extraction & contextual answers for Lumetix customer support transcripts at target traffic patterns, with acceptable latency and cost.

Target KPIs (agreed as start points):
- Latency: P95 generation latency <= 250ms for single-turn prompts at 2048 tokens.
- Throughput: sustained throughput of 150 concurrent requests (peak pattern) with autoscaling headroom for 20% burst.
- Cost: average token cost <= $0.0008 per generation (measured by Redwood token accounting).
- Quality: > 88% top-1 precision on the annotated test set and < 2% confident hallucination rate (evaluated on the provided 200-example evaluation set).

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Lumetix provides: 200 labeled examples (QA / ground truth), a 1-week replay of representative traffic (anonymized), and service account access for 2 engineers.
- Redwood provides: evaluation harness (automated scripts + metrics dashboard), runbook template, and an initial inference config (model family, quantization profile, batching policy).
- Owners: Sophie (Lumetix PM) — dataset + acceptance; Ben Carter (Redwood Sales Eng) — deployment tuning & throughput validation; Monica Patel (Redwood CS) — onboarding and reporting cadence.

Timeline (fast path):
- Week 0 (this week): access + dataset transfer, baseline profiling.
- Week 1: smoke test + latency/throughput tuning; initial quality readout on dev set.
- Week 2: full-run evaluation on replay & final KPI readouts; decision workshop.

Next steps (action items):
1) Sophie: share anonymized traffic replay S3 link and 200-example eval set by EOD Thursday (2026-12-16).
2) Lumetix infra: add redwood-poc@lumetix to allowlist for service account (instructions in Drive link).
3) Ben: provision test cluster and share temporary API keys.
4) Monica & I: schedule a 30-min decision workshop for 2026-12-20 to review results.

Attachments: initial success matrix stub (lumetix_poc_success_matrix.xlsx), Redwood runbook template (redwood_runbook_template.md).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: lumetix_poc_success_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_runbook_template.md (markdown)

From: Sophie Gray <sophie.gray@lumetix.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@lumetix.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-13T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Lumetix POC technical qualifiers & success checkpoints

Thanks Aisha — this looks good and captures the call. A few clarifications from our side:
- We can deliver the 200-example eval set by Thursday; the traffic replay will require a short anonymization step so expect a link by Friday morning.
- For the quality KPI: can Redwood confirm how you calculate the "confident hallucination rate"? We need to ensure consistent thresholds for the metrics.

Also, on cost: our finance team would prefer a midpoint SLO rather than a strict hard cap — would it be possible to capture cost as a measured KPI with a target and a stretch goal? Example: target <= $0.0008/token, stretch <= $0.0006/token.

I'll work with Daniel to add the allowlist entry for redwood-poc@lumetix by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Sophie
Product Manager — Lumetix

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Gray <sophie.gray@lumetix.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-14T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Lumetix POC technical qualifiers & success checkpoints

Sophie — good questions. Quick answers and a couple of technical asks so we can size the test cluster correctly:

1) Confident hallucination rate: we'll run the evaluation harness that computes a model confidence score per response. A response is flagged as a confident hallucination when model confidence >= 0.85 and the response does not match the annotated ground truth. We'll provide the calibration script so you can reproduce scores locally.

2) Cost accounting: Redwood will report tokenized input/output counts and raw cost from the selected model variant. We can publish both observed token cost and a normalized cost/token metric (USD per 1k tokens) in the dashboard. We'll capture target and stretch as requested — add both fields to the success matrix.

Technical sizing asks (needed before we provision):
- Expected average prompt length (tokens) for replay and 95th percentile length.
- Peak RPS during the 1-week replay window.
- Whether responses include streaming tokens (we size differently for streaming workloads).

If you can share the two numbers above (avg/95th token length and peak RPS) we can provision the cluster today and start baseline runs Monday.

I'll attach the profiling checklist and an example calibration script to the runbook.

— Ben
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: profiling_checklist.md (markdown)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@lumetix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sophie Gray <sophie.gray@lumetix.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-16T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Lumetix POC technical qualifiers & success checkpoints

Ben / Sophie — sharing the numbers you asked for below and the replay link:
- Avg prompt length (tokens): 380
- 95th percentile prompt length: 1,980
- Peak RPS observed in replay: 18 req/s (sustained bursts up to 24 req/s)

Traffic replay (anonymized): s3://lumetix-replay/2026-11-week1-anon.jsonl.gz

We do want streaming responses enabled for a subset of the workload (chat-style support flows) — about 30% of requests will be streaming.

Let us know if you need additional metadata from the logs.

— Daniel
Principal Engineer, Lumetix

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Gray <sophie.gray@lumetix.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@lumetix.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Lumetix POC technical qualifiers & success checkpoints

Team — quick status update before our decision workshop later today (30 minutes):
- Access: received S3 replay link and eval set; Redwood account allowlist confirmed.
- Provisioning: Ben has provisioned a 2-node test cluster with streaming-enabled routing for ~30% of traffic; initial baseline runs completed.
- Early numbers (dev subset): P95 latency = 220ms; throughput headroom tested to 160 concurrent synthetic connections; cost estimate ~ $0.00075/token (projected, pre-quantization).
- Quality: preliminary precision on eval subset = 86%; hallucination confident-rate = 2.4% (slightly above target). Ben is running a small prompt-tuning iteration to push quality above 88% before the workshop.

Agenda for the 12/20 workshop (30 min):
1) Review final readouts (latency, throughput, cost, quality) — Ben
2) Discuss acceptance gating and next-phase options (increase dataset, longer replay) — Sophie + Lumetix
3) Sign-off criteria and commercial next steps (Aisha)

If the numbers land within target+stretch we'll recommend moving to a 3-month pilot procurement conversation. See dashboard link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCPlan

— Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
